plan.description: Engine-test fixture start state. Legal outcomes: advance to build, or blocked.

build.description: Engine-test work state. Legal outcomes: complete (terminal), or blocked.

review_remediation_plan.description: Engine-test SECOND cerebrate planning state (remediation-style name). Proves the engine's plan-write authorization is agent==cerebrate, not name==plan: a cerebrate state under a different name may persist plan.steps.

checkpoint.description: Engine-test SKILL-type state (producer-authorization type-gate proof). A skill state is NOT an agent producer, so an outputs.completed_steps rider recorded here MUST be rejected — proving the guard needs type==agent, not merely a non-cerebrate agent value.

version_bump.description: Engine-test SINGULAR-agent non-cerebrate state (producer-authorization narrowing proof). Declares `agent` (not `allowed_agents`), so it is NOT wave-producing: an outputs.completed_steps rider recorded here MUST be rejected under the narrowed guard, even though the old broad (type==agent && agent!=cerebrate) predicate would have accepted it.

cerebrate_wave.description: Engine-test wave-shaped state whose allowed_agents is EXCLUSIVELY cerebrate (producer-authorization exclusion-belt proof). An outputs.completed_steps rider recorded here MUST be rejected — allowed_agents alone does not authorize crediting when the roster is cerebrate-only.
